articleTitle: Deception Detection from Linguistic and Physiological Data Streams Using Bimodal Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Deception detection is gaining increasing interest due to ethical and security concerns. This paper explores the application of convolutional neural networks for the purpose of multimodal deception detection. We use a dataset built by interviewing 104 subjects about two topics, with one truthful and one falsified response from each subject about each topic. In particular, we make three main contributions. First, we extract linguistic and physiological features from this data to train and construct the neural network models. Second, we propose a fused convolutional neural network model using both modalities in order to achieve an improved overall performance. Third, we compare our new approach with earlier methods designed for multimodal deception detection. We find that our system outperforms regular classification methods; our results indicate the feasibility of using neural networks for deception detection even in the presence of limited amounts of data.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Encoder-Decoder Network Architecture for Reducing Information Loss in Image Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The traditional SegNet architecture commonly encounters significant information loss during the sampling process, which detrimentally affects its accuracy in image semantic segmentation tasks. To counter this challenge, we introduce an innovative encoder-decoder network structure enhanced with residual connections. Our approach employs a multi-residual connection strategy designed to preserve the intricate details across various image scales more effectively, thus minimizing the information loss inherent to down-sampling procedures. Additionally, to enhance the convergence rate of network training and mitigate sample imbalance issues, we have devised a modified cross-entropy loss function incorporating a balancing factor. This modification optimizes the distribution between positive and negative samples, thus improving the efficiency of model training. Experimental evaluations of our model demonstrate a substantial reduction in information loss and improved accuracy in semantic segmentation. Notably, our proposed network architecture demonstrates a substantial improvement in the finely annotated mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on the dataset compared to the conventional SegNet. The proposed network structure not only reduces operational costs by decreasing manual inspection needs but also scales up the deployment of AI-driven image analysis across different sectors.

articleTitle: Predict Click-Through Rates with Deep Interest Network Model in E-commerce Advertising
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper proposes new methods to enhance click-through rate (CTR) prediction models using the Deep Interest Network (DIN) model, specifically applied to the advertising system of Alibaba’s Taobao platform. Unlike traditional deep learning approaches, this research focuses on localized user behavior activation for tailored ad targeting by leveraging extensive user behavior data. Compared to traditional models, this method demonstrates superior ability to handle diverse and dynamic user data, thereby improving the efficiency of ad systems and increasing revenue.

articleTitle: Green Communication Systems: Towards Sustainable Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive examination of Green Communication Systems, focusing on strategies, technologies, and practices aimed at minimizing energy consumption and environmental impact in communication networks. Through an exploration of energy-efficient networking, renewable energy integration, optimization techniques, and policy considerations, this paper highlights the importance of sustainability in the telecommunications industry. Case studies and future directions are also discussed to offer insights into practical implementations and emerging trends.

articleTitle: Research on Driver Facial Fatigue Detection Based on Yolov8 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In a society where traffic accidents frequently occur, fatigue driving has emerged as a grave issue. Fatigue driving detection technology, especially those based on the YOLOv8 deep learning model, has seen extensive research and application as an effective preventive measure. This paper discusses in depth the methods and technologies utilized in the YOLOv8 model to detect driver fatigue, elaborates on the current research status both domestically and internationally, and systematically introduces the processing methods and algorithm principles for various datasets. This study aims to provide a robust technical solution for preventing and detecting fatigue driving, thereby contributing significantly to reducing traffic accidents and safeguarding lives.

articleTitle: Intelligent Communication System for Poultry Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of the design and implementation of an intelligent communication system tailored for poultry manufacturing. The proposed system integrates various technologies such as Internet of Things (IoT), big data analytics, machine learning, and automation to optimize production processes, ensure animal welfare, and improve overall efficiency. By leveraging real-time data collection, analysis, and decision support, the system empowers poultry farmers with actionable insights for better management and decision-making. Additionally, remote monitoring and management capabilities enable farmers to access critical information and control systems from anywhere, enhancing operational flexibility and responsiveness. The paper discusses the key components of the system, its potential benefits, and challenges associated with its deployment. Furthermore, it highlights relevant research studies and references contributing to the development and advancement of intelligent communication systems in poultry manufacturing.

articleTitle: Enhance Image-to-Image Generation with LLaVA-generated Prompts
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to enhance image-to-image generation by leveraging the multimodal capabilities of the Large Language and Vision Assistant (LLaVA). We propose a framework where LLaVA analyzes input images and generates textual descriptions, hereinafter LLaVA-generated prompts. These prompts, along with the original image, are fed into the image-to-image generation pipeline. This enriched representation guides the generation process towards outputs that exhibit a stronger resemblance to the input image. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of LLaVA-generated prompts in promoting image similarity. We observe a significant improvement in the visual coherence between the generated and input images compared to traditional methods. Future work will explore fine-tuning LLaVA prompts for increased control over the creative process. By providing more specific details within the prompts, we aim to achieve a delicate balance between faithfulness to the original image and artistic expression in the generated outputs.

articleTitle: Feature Fusion-Based Detection of SQL Injection and XSS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the internet, network security issues are becoming increasingly severe. SQL injection attacks and XSS attacks are two common network attack methods that pose serious threats to the security of websites and applications. Traditional feature-matching-based detection methods struggle to cope with increasingly complex attack techniques, necessitating the development of more effective detection methods. This paper proposes a deep learning-based model for detecting SQL injection and XSS attacks, which integrates local and global features, captures long-term dependencies in sequential data, and focuses more on the relevant parts of the input data. Experimental results show that this model achieves superior performance compared to other mainstream methods across multiple datasets.

articleTitle: Challenges of Data Consistency in High-Concurrency Environments: Algorithms and Implementation for the Electric Power Industrial Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Electric Power Industrial Internet, challenges in high-concurrency data processing have become increasingly prominent, particularly issues related to data consistency, which directly affect the stability and reliability of the system. This study addresses the distributed data consistency problems in the Electric Power Industrial Internet platform, proposing an optimized algorithmic framework designed specifically for high concurrency and dynamic environments to enhance the response speed and data processing capabilities of the power system. This paper first analyzes common data consistency challenges in high-concurrency environments within the power system, including data synchronization delays, complexity in fault recovery, and resource allocation issues. Based on these challenges, we introduce and optimize distributed data consistency algorithms, combined with load balancing and resource optimization techniques, significantly reducing communication costs and enhancing processing efficiency. Additionally, the paper designs a robust fault tolerance mechanism to ensure data integrity and consistency in the event of node failures. Through simulation experiments, we have confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms in terms of processing speed, system response time, and fault recovery, significantly optimizing the performance of the Electric Power Industrial Internet platform. This research not only enhances the robustness of the power system in facing high-concurrency data challenges but also provides important technical support and a theoretical basis for future research and applications in the Electric Power Industrial Internet.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Knowledge Graph for Oil and Gas Pipeline Accidents Based on Graph Database
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, knowledge graph technology has developed rapidly, and the value of domain knowledge graphs has been recognized. Experts in various fields have conducted extensive research on the construction of knowledge graphs, and have successfully applied them to services such as knowledge retrieval, question and answer, and knowledge recommendation. Taking oil and gas pipeline safety accident data as the main data source, relevant information is extracted through conceptual model design, knowledge extraction, and other steps. It is integrated with the original structured data. With the help of the Neo4j graph database, a pipeline safety system integrating oil and gas pipeline safety accident data and relevant regulations is constructed. The knowledge graph in the accident field enables the storage and visualization of oil and gas pipeline safety information.

articleTitle: Construction of a Public Service Platform for Capability Verification Based on Recommendation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Construction of a Public Service Platform for Power Capacity Verification Based on Recommendation Algorithms.Utilizing big data and artificial intelligence technologies, this study preprocessed historical power capacity verification data to establish and train a recommendation algorithm model for matching the supply and demand of providers and participants. Once the training met the required standards, the accuracy of this algorithm was validated within the core business processes of power capacity verification. The research delved deeply into the needs of all stakeholders in the power capacity verification field, integrating resources from various parties. By using unified data standards, business processes, and business description methods, a nationwide public service platform for power capacity verification was constructed. The application of the recommendation algorithm model on this platform demonstrated a superior fit for matching supply and demand of power capacity verification providers and participants compared to platforms without such algorithms. The construction of this public service platform based on recommendation algorithms has enhanced the informatization and intelligence level of the power capacity verification industry. It has also contributed to improving the supply-demand relationship in the industry and, to some extent, promoted the technical level and service quality of power capacity verification providers.

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Based on Contrast Enhancement and Multi-scale Edge-preserving Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To improve the contrast of details, an infrared and visible image fusion method based on contrast enhancement and multi-scale edge-preserving decomposition is proposed. A multi-scale contrast adaptive enhancement algorithm is used to improve the visibility of visible images before the fusion. The contrast of details can be effectively enhanced with this method. Then, fusion rules are designed according to the properties of different layers to preserve the restored information as much as possible. In order to retain more texture information of source images, the parameter-adaptive model is applied to fuse the small-scale detail layer. In order to avoid mutual interference of different characteristic images, a new edge detection method is used to fuse large-scale detail layer. In order to improve the contrast of fusion results, the weighted averaging technique based on visual saliency map is used to fuse the basic layer. Finally, a clear image is obtained by combining the fused layers. The experimental results show that the proposed method has better visual effect than other fusion methods.

articleTitle: FedLAQ: Adaptive Quantization with Layer-wise Bucketing for Communication-efficient Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables the collaborative training of a global model by distributed edge devices, without necessitating the sharing of their local datasets. Yet, FL incurs considerable communication overhead, primarily due to the server and clients' recurrent exchange of model updates, particularly from uploading gradients from the clients. To address this problem, most existing research utilizes quantization, which compresses model parameters from high-precision floating point numbers to fixed-point numbers. However, current quantization approaches may lead to underflow due to varying gradient distributions and cause the model to fail to converge. Moreover, these approaches are either fixed or unrelated to the training status, failing to adequately balance performance and efficiency. In this work, an innovative quantization algorithm, FedLAQ, is introduced, designed to solve the communication bottleneck without compromising model accuracy. Specifically, FedLAQ relates the strength of quantization to the training status using a TCP-inspired strategy, and quantization is performed at a layer level with finer and coarser granularity. Experiments demonstrate that FedLAQ significantly enhances client-to-server compression, surpassing the top-performing baselines (e.g., QSGD) by up to a factor of 1.73.

articleTitle: Reliability Test of Control Loop Information in New Power Load Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of stochastic forest in the detection of new power load management system, and deals with regression and classification problems by integrating multiple decision tree subtrees. Since each decision tree produces one result, when the number of input samples is N, N classification results will be produced. Finally, all classification results will be selected through a voting mechanism. Random forest algorithm combines Bagging idea and decision tree, where a single decision tree as a weak classifier has the defect of weak generalization ability, but the integrated model becomes a strong classifier. This ensemble learning approach improves the accuracy of classification and prediction, but at the expense of interoperability, i.e. the difficulty of determining decisive variables. Improve the performance of the overall model by combining multiple base models. CART decision trees determine which attribute should be given a higher weight based on the minimum Gini index, which provides a measure of descriptive impurity content and is calculated in a way designed to optimize the tree's performance.

articleTitle: Research on Information System Architecture Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To construct an information system architecture system based on microservice architecture in in a highly distributed and multi-source heterogeneous environment, the goal is to enhance and improve the software ecosystem. This will meet the demands for high availability and concurrency of the information system, as well as effectively allocate and utilize resources according to market and business requirements. The article aims to define and explain the concept of an information system based on microservice architecture, elaborate on the construction methods (including direct construction and microservice-oriented transformation), compare, and analyze mainstream microservice frameworks, construct the information system architecture, function module, and operation mechanism based on microservice architecture. The architectural design of an information system based on microservice involves constructing modules that align with business requirements (capabilities), characteristics of the information system, and environmental considerations. Microservices are selected accordingly with expansion optimization aligned with business functions. The structure consists of display layer, interface layer, service layer data layer and infrastructure layer. Functional modules within this framework include shared microservices, customized/applied microservices and basic microservices.

articleTitle: Optimization of C-V2X Mode 4 Resource Scheduling Protocol Based on CAM Generation Frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the cellular Internet of Vehicles (C-V2X) system, the most important message type in vehicle-vehicle communication (V2V) is cooperative aware message (CAM). When transmitting CAM messages, the existing S-SPS resource scheduling protocols use a fixed range of resource re-selection counters (RC) to take the value, which leads to uneven spectrum resource scheduling, resulting in resource waste. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved S-SPS resource scheduling protocol for CAM data streams, which optimizes the value of RC according to the generation frequency of CAM data streams and vehicle density, so as to improve the utilization rate of system resources and reduce the collision probability. In order to study the performance of the improved protocol, this paper establishes a discrete-time Markov chain model to obtain the system average delay, collision probability, channel utilization and other performance indicators. Numerical simulation results show that compared with the classical protocol, the improved protocol reduces the average delay by 31.59%, the average collision probability by 15.03%, and the channel utilization rate by 15.74% in single-stream transmission. Therefore, the effectiveness of the improved protocol is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Network Intrusion Detection Technology Based on Honeypot
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of the network, people are becoming more and more dependent on the network for their work and lives, this makes the network environment complex. At the same time, cyberattack methods are constantly changing, new types of cyberattacks are on the rise. In this case, traditional passive defense techniques are very limited in dealing with new types of unknown attacks. To solve this problem, a honeypot-based network intrusion detection method is studied in this paper, combine proactive defense techniques with passive defense techniques, on this basis, an intrusion detection and signature generation system integrating honeypot technology was designed. The system deploys honeypots to trap attackers, captures realtime traffic information flowing through honeypot nodes, parses the packet content according to the network protocol, and uses machine learning detection models to detect the collected realtime traffic information.

articleTitle: Modified Recurrent Neural Networks for Incomplete Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Time series forecasting is one of the most common and important problems in time series related tasks. With the rise of deep learning models, time series forecasting develops rapidly. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) were first proposed in 1990 to solve the problem of timing series forecasting with deep learning. After that, LSTM, GRU and other models were developed. In recent years, along with the emergence of models based on the Attention mechanism, a series of methods for timing series forecasting have been proposed based on Transformer. Complete and accurate data sampling of time series signals is the most ideal laboratory condition. But the sampling in real signal processing tasks is mostly incomplete. The existing methods are not satisfied for the forecasting results under incomplete sampling conditions. This paper aims to propose a modified RNN method to improve the forecasting effect of time series under incomplete sampling conditions.

articleTitle: WHW: An Efficient Data Organization Method for Fine-tuning Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: There are still deficiencies in fine-tuning technology for Large Language Models (LLM) in the industrial field. Fine-tuned large language models often fail to achieve expected results, and the following problems usually occur: (1) LLM hallucination: A common problem with generative models is that the generated content is uncontrollable and limited to tasks within the vertical domain. (2) LLM does not perform well in fine-tuning on domain data: The training data of the base generative large language model is relatively common. It is difficult to make domain knowledge fully exert its influence on large models trained with general knowledge. (3) Insufficient training samples: In few-shot learning, the fine-tuning results of large language models are often worse or unable to learn domain knowledge. In order to solve the above problems encountered in the fine-tuning of large language models, we propose an efficient fine-tuning data organization method. Our data approach works by adding domain-specific task descriptions. Improves the results of vertical domain fine-tuning of large language models, reduces LLM hallucination, and uses only a small number of instructions to fine-tune data. Specifically, we provided detailed descriptions and restrictions on vertical domain tasks by manually constructing task description data WHW (What, How, Why), which improved the F1 score by 11% in the role setting task and by 3% in the classification task. While reducing the LLM hallucination by 73% compared with the prompt fine-tune method.

articleTitle: Classification Assistance Based Image Inpainting for BR code
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Recently, many image inpainting methods have achieved promising performance in recovering damaged natural images in various scenes. Different from natural images, blur-readable (BR) 2D barcode images have distinct structural characteristics, such as finder patterns (represent the version information) and data bits. Version information is crucial for decoding BR code. The problem of missing data bits can be solved by image inpainting methods and error correction codes. However, when the finder patterns are damaged, they may not be correctly repaired through the inpainting technology, resulting in the failure of barcode recognition. The limitation of existing image inpainting algorithms is that the version information of BR code cannot be obtained while generating repaired result. In this paper, we innovatively introduce the classification task into the inpainting network and propose a classification assistance based inpainting model for BR code (CAII). Experiment results show that our method can efficiently enhance the readability of damaged BR code images.

articleTitle: RF-YOLO: A Small Target Detection Algorithm for UAV Aerial Photography Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that in aerial image detection tasks, both the object and overall image size are small, and the detail information is not clear, which results in leakage and misdetection, this paper proposes a small target detection algorithm BiRF-YOLO for UAV aerial images. Taking YOLOv8s as the base model, firstly, the PANet is replaced with BiFPN, and an additional P2 detection layer to enhance the small target detection capability. In addition, a new module RF_C2f is proposed to transfer the attention space features to the sensory field space features, which allows the network to understand and process the local regions in the image more efficiently, thus improving the accuracy of feature extraction. The experimental results show that BiRF-YOLO improves mAP50 by 7.8% and mAP50:95 by 5.1%.

articleTitle: FLMP: Optimizing Training Efficiency of Federated Learning Using Model Pruning with Layer Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a privacy-preserving method for distributed clients to collaboratively train a model without exposing their raw data. However, the limited communication bandwidth and insufficient computing capacity of clients hinder the efficient deployment of FL applications. Besides, the diverse data distribution among clients may also degrade model performance. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose a novel framework called FLMP. Specifically, our FLMP dynamically identifies and eliminates redundant components within models by analyzing representation similarity and filter importance based on clients' data. This process produces multiple optimal sub-models that are tailored to client capacities. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that, Compared with other baselines, our proposed framework achieves better performance in both i.i.d and challenging non-i.i.d data scenarios. It achieves up to a 12.31% improvement in model accuracy while maintaining similar communication and computation costs.

articleTitle: ADWT : Effective Air Quality Prediction Via Discrete Wavelet Transform and Attention based Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Nowadays, how to achieve accurate air quality prediction has become a topic of great concern. However, how to effectively learn spatial and temporal correlations in the view of both long-term trend and short-term event is nontrival. To address this issue, in this paper, we propose a novel deep learning model called ADWT, which is composed of discrete wavelet transformation and spatio-temporal attention mechanism. Specifically, We employ the graph attention-based model to learn implicit spatial features from air quality data, and further refine the temporal information by extracting the high-frequency and low-frequency components. Experimental results on real-world dataset demonstrate the superior of our proposed model.

articleTitle: Low Light Image Enhancement Based on a Pyramid Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the process of low light image enhancement, there are problems such as information loss and unclear image details after enhancement. An improved method for low light image enhancement based on the pyramid diffusion model is proposed. The method improves the U-net network structure based on the pyramid diffusion model. A global and local perceptual network architecture is designed for further processing of the downsampled images. The global module captures the global context information through the channel attention mechanism. The local module constructs multi-scale feature block to extract image features at different scales. For provide fine-grained details, the local module uses contrast information to process and enhance the characterization of local features. Finally, an interactive fusion module is designed to fuse different features from the global branch and local branch. The mothod also improves the residual network and uses skip connection with convolution to connect the downsampling and upsampling. Experimental results on the LOL and LOLv2 datasets show that the improved method has better results, which demonstrates the effectiveness of this design.

articleTitle: Inverse Relational Reasoning Based on 3D-CRN Direction Relation Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, although a number of spatial directional relation models have been proposed, the reasoning ability of spatial directional relations is limited due to the inherent defects of some models and the weak research on the corresponding reasoning techniques, which reduces the usefulness of the models to a certain extent. Based on the 3D-CRN directional relation expression and inference model, combining three-dimensional algebra and qualitative coordinates, establishing equivalent links, an automatic qualitative inference algorithm for the inverse relation between principal directional relations is proposed, which gets rid of the dependence on manual inference tables, greatly improves the operational efficiency, and increases the practicality of the model. The results of theoretical analysis and example verification show that the algorithm effectively improves the accuracy of reasoning and reduces the time complexity of reasoning.

articleTitle: Improved Coal Gangue Recognition Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To solve the problems of poor recognition and low speed of the coal gangue sorting task in the coal mining industry, a coal gangue recognition and detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5s is proposed. The MobileNetV3 network is used as the backbone to reduce the network's calculation and parameter count. The SimAM attention module is integrated to further reduce the network's parameter count while improving the network's accuracy. At the output detection end of the network, a DyHead dynamic attention detection head is used to obtain more critical expression features in three dimensions: scale, space and task. By using the Alpha-IoU loss function, the detection network can more accurately locate the bounding box of the target object. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm achieves an average accuracy of 94.8%, an increase in detection speed to 109.38 FPS and a reduction in the number of parameters and computations to 59.57% and 46.88% respectively of YOLOv5s. The improved algorithm achieves the requirement for gangue detection.

articleTitle: Research on Large-scale Data Anomaly Detection based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous progress of big data, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence and other technologies, we are living in an era of information explosion. A large amount of data is constantly recorded, and this data contains important information at the critical moment. With the rapid increase in data volume, traditional statistical methods are gradually unable to meet the needs due to high computational complexity and poor adaptability. In this work, we utilize autoencoder and generative adversarial network deep learning methods to detect anomalies in large-scale data. Autoencoders learn low-dimensional representations of data through the encoding and decoding process, and are mainly used to reconstruct normal data and identify anomalies by reconstructing errors. The generative adversarial network grasps the distribution characteristics of the data through the adversarial learning of its generative model and discriminant model, and uses this ability to detect abnormal patterns in the data. The effectiveness of the proposed model was verified by conducting experiments on multiple real-world datasets. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional method, the proposed deep learning model has significant improvement in detection accuracy and computing efficiency.

articleTitle: Application Research of Emotion Analysis, Eye Tracking, and Head Movement Monitoring Based on Facial Recognition Algorithms in ESL Student Engagement Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This article explores the innovative use of emotion analysis, eye tracking, and head movement tracking with facial recognition to assess ESL students' classroom participation. It overviews the principles and practices of these technologies in education, focusing on facial recognition and emotion analysis to help teachers understand students' emotions in real-time. Experimental data shows how eye tracking evaluates students' attention, while head movement tracking provides intuitive data on student activity. The article discusses challenges and future directions of this multi-technology integration, highlighting its potential to enhance teaching interaction and student engagement. It anticipates the widespread impact of technology-based educational tools in global education.

articleTitle: An Improved Secretary Bird Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The traditional secretary bird optimization algorithm is known to exhibit certain deficiencies, including a slow convergence speed and a tendency to fall into local optimization. This paper presents an enhanced version of the algorithm, addressing these limitations. The proposed algorithm incorporates three key innovations. First, it employs Circle chaotic mapping to generate an initialized population with greater biodiversity. Second, it integrates a differential evolution strategy into the iterative process, balancing global search and local optimization to improve convergence accuracy. Additionally, a population diversity strategy is introduced to enhance convergence speed and optimization accuracy. This strategy was tested on six benchmark functions and compared with other optimization algorithms. Experimental results demonstrate that ISBOA achieves optimal convergence speed and optimization accuracy, validating its effectiveness on complex problems.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of Terminal Node Eligibility Assessment in Power Load Management Using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Efficient management of electrical loads is pivotal in optimizing power distribution and ensuring stability within power grids. A critical aspect of this process involves accurately determining the eligibility of terminal nodes to maintain seamless operation and support. This paper introduces a novel approach, employing fully connected Neural Network, to assess the eligibility of terminal nodes based on five key attributes: RAM, Storage, Trust Factor, Distance, and Transmission Rate. We have designed a sequential model architecture consisting of multiple dense layers, each followed by ReLU activation, culminating in a linear output that classifies nodes as eligible or not. The dataset comprises historical data points from various nodes within an operational power load management system, which have been standardized and normalized to aid in effective model training and validation. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Neural Network model achieves high accuracy and robustness in predicting node eligibility, offering significant improvements over traditional statistical methods. Additionally, this study not only enhances the understanding of node behavior within electrical grids but also paves the way for more sophisticated AI-driven approaches in energy systems management.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Based on Digital Twin Modeling of Bearings
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As critical rotating machinery components, the monitoring of the health status and fault diagnosis of bearings become particularly important. In this paper, a bearing digital twin model and fault diagnosis system based on ANSYS and Matlab is proposed. First, a high-precision digital twin model of the bearing was constructed using ANSYS software, which can simulate the physical behavior of the bearing under different working conditions. Subsequently, a Matlab-based fault diagnosis system was developed, which is able to read vibration data automatically and extract fault features through an improved spectral cliff algorithm and deconvolution algorithm. The system is designed with a modular architecture, including key aspects such as data acquisition, signal preprocessing, feature extraction and fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that the proposed system outperforms the traditional methods in terms of the accuracy of fault detection and the efficiency of diagnosis.

articleTitle: Visual Feature Transfer in Reinforcement Learning: Robot Control Using Raw Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Learning strategies from raw image inputs is an important problem in reinforcement learning. However, unlike the deep convolutional networks widely used in the computer vision field, the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) used in reinforcement learning often have smaller scales. Therefore, in this paper, we explore the use of deep visual models pre-trained on external datasets as feature extractors, and apply them without fine-tuning for downstream tasks. Finally, we evaluate our method on robot control tasks. Even when using unprocessed raw images as input and without observing any frame of the simulation environment during training, our pre-trained feature extractor can still match the ground truth feature, and the model converges faster in downstream tasks. We also investigate the performance of using outputs from different depth hidden layers as pre-trained features in downstream tasks, and analyze the hierarchical relationship of features and their performance in control tasks.

articleTitle: A Multi-Source Retrieval Question Answering Framework Based on RAG
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of large-scale language models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has been widely adopted. However, existing RAG paradigms are inevitably influenced by erroneous retrieval information, thereby reducing the reliability and correctness of generated results. Therefore, to improve the relevance of retrieval information, this study proposes a method that replaces traditional retrievers with GPT-3.5, leveraging its vast corpus knowledge to generate retrieval information. We also propose a web retrieval based method to implement fine-grained knowledge retrieval, Utilizing the powerful reasoning capability of GPT-3.5 to realize semantic partitioning of problem. In order to mitigate the illusion of GPT retrieval and reduce noise in Web retrieval, we proposes a multi-source retrieval framework, named MSRAG, which combines GPT retrieval with web retrieval. Experiments on multiple knowledge-intensive QA datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework in this study performs better than existing RAG framework in enhancing the overall efficiency and accuracy of QA systems.

articleTitle: Optimization Calculation Algorithm for Radiation Parameters Based on Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aerodynamic optics has important research value in many fields such as aerospace optical sensors, remote sensing detection and so on. The traditional gas radiation calculation models are insufficient in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. In this paper, an algorithm is proposed to calculate the absorption coefficient of gas radiation based on the improved limit learning machine model. It can improve the calculation efficiency on the basis of accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Point Cloud Data Processing in Multiple Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of 3D laser scanning technology, point cloud data has been widely used in various fields. As the most critical link after the point cloud data collection, the denoising process of point cloud data directly affects the subsequent point cloud data splicing, 3D reconstruction and other links. At present, there are still gaps in the research of point cloud data processing methods under different application scenarios. Therefore, this paper studies the statistical filtering and radius filtering methods of point cloud data in different scenarios and environments, and combines the characteristics of the two filtering methods to obtain a point cloud data filtering method suitable for different scenarios.

articleTitle: Soldier Detection Based on Deep Learning and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In today's complex battlefield environment, traditional combat methods have proven to be inadequate. With the rapid development of computer vision and target detection technologies, the demand for intelligent weapons to automatically identify soldier targets is becoming increasingly prominent. This study aims to explore the soldier target detection problem through deep learning by leveraging an improved YOLOv8 algorithm. Initially, a diverse set of soldier data was collected using methods such as web scraping and movie screenshots, and subjected to preprocessing techniques like data augmentation to construct a dataset covering a comprehensive range of scenarios. Subsequently, the GAM attention mechanism was introduced to further enhance model performance. The experimental results clearly demonstrate that compared to the base model, the proposed optimized model exhibits superior capabilities in multitarget prediction and occlusion detection in soldier target detection tasks, showcasing outstanding detection efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Statistical-based Precursor Operator Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper explores the execution relation between database operators, specifically precursor relations, and their impact on optimizing computer system performance. The study defines these precursor relations and discovers that they significantly influence the data transfer volume between the host and storage ends, thereby affecting query execution efficiency. Given that precursor relations can vary with changes in query statements or optimization strategies, this paper introduces a statistical method for analyzing precursor operators. This method generates operator precursor probability tables for specific databases, allowing for the determination of the priority of database operators delegated to the storage end.

articleTitle: Improving Carbon Emission Predictions with NLP and LSTM Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, the urgency of addressing climate change has intensified, necessitating accurate predictions of carbon emissions to inform policy decisions and mitigation strategies. This paper presents an innovative approach to improving carbon emission prediction models by integrating Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. Initially, a baseline LSTM model is developed to forecast carbon emissions using historical emission data. Subsequently, we incorporate NLP-processed information extracted from relevant textual sources such as government reports, news articles, and scientific papers. Key features, including keywords, thematic distributions, and sentiment scores, are derived from the text and combined with numerical data to create a multi modal input for the LSTM model. Experimental results demonstrate that the inclusion of NLP-enhanced features significantly enhances the model’s predictive accuracy. This study underscores the potential of leveraging textual data to enrich traditional prediction models, providing a more comprehensive tool for understanding and forecasting carbon emission trends.

articleTitle: A Columnar Storage Cone Search Method for Massive Astronomical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous advancement of astronomical instrument manufacturing technology, astronomical observation data has shown an exponential growth trend, and traditional database technologies are no longer able to meet the storage and retrieval performance requirements. To address the challenges of storing massive astronomical data and efficient cone search, a solution utilizing columnar storage is proposed, leveraging the separate storage of each attribute column in columnar storage for independent retrieval to enhance data read efficiency. Building upon this, a specialized cone search area retrieval method tailored for columnar storage mode is introduced to reduce data read and computation in cone search, further enhancing retrieval efficiency.

articleTitle: Generation Method of Turbine Blade Surface Model Based on Multi-Slice CT Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for generating the surface model of hollow turbine blades based on the fusion of Industrial Computerized Tomography (ICT) multi-directional slice data. Through the Normal Distribution Transformation (NDT) algorithm and the Iterative Closest Points (ICP) algorithm, the registration fusion of CT multi-directional slice data is achieved, obtaining turbine blade point cloud data containing more comprehensive key structural features. The Delaunay triangulation algorithm is used for surface model generation, obtaining a detailed model of the entire inner and outer surfaces of the hollow turbine blades.

articleTitle: Improvements based on Adaptive Monte Carlo Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper presents an improved indoor localization and navigation method primarily based on Channel State Information (CSI) fingerprinting and Adaptive Monte Carlo Localization (AMCL) technology. Wi-Fi localization offers convenience and flexibility, allowing it to be applied in different environments and easily extended to cover larger areas. However, it lacks accuracy. On the other hand, the AMCL algorithm provides precision but is limited by indoor environmental constraints and complex computations. By combining the two, this method addresses these issues without requiring excessive computational complexity, resulting in a more accurate and efficient localization system. Experimental results show that this approach significantly enhances the global localization accuracy and navigation capabilities of robots in complex indoor environments. This achievement not only optimizes the performance of indoor robot navigation systems but also provides an effective implementation strategy for future indoor localization technologies.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Scheduling of Thermal Power Unit Thermal Storage Capacity Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: At present, the traditional low carbon scheduling method of thermal power unit thermal storage capacity realizes the scheduling of thermal storage capacity by establishing a thermal power coordination model. Due to the lack of analysis on the operation characteristics of thermal power units, the scheduling effect is poor and the carbon emission cost is high. Therefore, a low carbon scheduling method for thermal power unit storage capacity based on particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. The operation characteristics of thermal power unit are analyzed, and the pressure parameters, capacity level and fuel type of the unit are divided by the baseline. Different carbon emission allowances are allocated to the units, and the operation mechanism of the heat storage device is optimized. The low carbon scheduling model of thermal power unit thermal storage capacity is constructed and solved by using particle swarm optimization algorithm. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed low carbon scheduling method for thermal power units has good scheduling performance.

articleTitle: Research on Fine-Grained Image Classification Based on Data Enhancement and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The research content of fine-grained image recognition is the problem of sub-category recognition under a broad category. Since fine-grained image classification has the data characteristics of little difference between classes and big difference within classes, it becomes a very challenging research task. The key to solving this task is to find the key regions in images and extract effective features from them. Based on the analysis and research of existing fine-grained image classification algorithms and models, this paper introduces a weakly supervised fine-grained classification method that utilizes cutmix data augmentation. SE attention module is introduced to enhance the significant regional features of images, and label smoothing mechanism is used to improve the model generalization ability. Compared with traditional methods on CUB_200_2011 dataset, the experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves improved classification performance.

articleTitle: Software Defect Classification and Analysis Study
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This study proposes a set of improved defect categorization criteria and analysis strategies based on a synthesis of a variety of commonly used software defect categorization methods, combined with the actual software development and testing process. By exploring the defect analysis process, this paper discusses the application of this standard in practice. Finally, basic methods and processes are proposed for software defect prevention, providing theoretical and practical guidance for quality management in the software development process.

articleTitle: Food and Herbals - Diseases and Symptoms Relation Extraction Method based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The relationship between food and disease holds significant importance in traditional medicine and healthcare practices. However, when it comes to disseminating dietary and health-related information, the news media often falls short in terms of authority and accuracy. To address this issue, this paper introduces a method for extracting relationships among food, herbals, diseases, and symptoms leveraging BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) framework. The method utilizes Transfer Learning to fine-tune the BERT pretraining model on an existing dataset to enable the model to recognize entities such as food, herbals, diseases, symptoms from unstructured text found in various literature sources. Following entity recognition, an entity embedding masking process is employed to construct a tailored training dataset specifically designed for entity relationship extraction. By combining entity recognition and relationship extraction, this method effectively uncovers the connections between food, herbals, diseases, and symptoms. The experimental results: Named Entity Recognition precision rate of 93.51%, a recall of 92.22%, and F1 of 92.86%. Relation Extraction accuracy of 91.99%, F1 of 93.88%. This method addresses the scarcity of annotated data in this domain, offering a method for automatic extraction of entity relationships, even without the need for expert annotations.

articleTitle: Prioritized Experience Replay-Based DDQN for Unmanned Vehicle Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Path planning module is a key module for autonomous vehicle navigation, which directly affects its operating efficiency and safety. In complex environments with many obstacles, traditional planning algorithms often cannot meet the needs of intelligence, which may lead to problems such as dead zones in unmanned vehicles. This paper proposes a path planning algorithm based on DDQN and combines it with the prioritized experience replay method to solve the problem that traditional path planning algorithms often fall into dead zones. A series of simulation experiment results prove that the path planning algorithm based on DDQN is significantly better than other methods in terms of speed and accuracy, especially the ability to break through dead zones in extreme environments. Research shows that the path planning algorithm based on DDQN performs well in terms of path quality and safety. These research results provide an important reference for the research on automatic navigation of autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Multi-modal Big Data Security Fusion Method Based on Privacy ASE Encryption Algorithm and Width Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The network is open, which makes it vulnerable to attacks and reduces the accuracy of multi-modal big data security fusion. To solve this problem, a multi-modal big data security fusion method based on privacy ASE encryption algorithm and width learning is proposed. Based on the privacy ASE encryption algorithm, each type of multimodal data is defined, and the corresponding attributes are defined, and the key tree of multimodal big data security fusion is constructed. According to the results of multi-modal big data security fusion based on privacy ASE encryption algorithm, the width learning technology is adopted to continue the fusion processing, generate a key protocol, divide normal nodes and malicious nodes, eliminate the information of malicious nodes, calculate the weights of multi-modal big data information fusion, set constraints, and get the results of multi-modal big data information security fusion. The experimental results show that the correlation coefficient of adjacent data managed by this method is low, and the average correlation coefficient is 0.037, so the data security is high. There is a small gap between the obtained fusion results and the ideal results, which effectively guarantees the credibility of the fusion process.

articleTitle: Medical Glass Bottle Mouth Defect Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: A glass bottle mouth defect detection method based on YOLOv5s network improvement is proposed to address the issue of high false detection and missed detection rates in traditional glass bottle mouth defect detection. Firstly, adding a small object detection layer to improve the network's accuracy in detecting small objects, thereby enhancing the model's ability to cope with cluttered backgrounds. Secondly, in the feature fusion network, the simplified BIFPN is integrated to better achieve multi-scale feature fusion without increasing computational costs. Finally, the improved model is used as the student model for knowledge distillation to improve the accuracy of object detection. The experimental results show that the improved YOLO-XBK model has improved AP and increased mAP by 4.5%, indicating that the improved network has higher detection accuracy and proves the practicality and efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Service Splitting and Governance of E-commerce System Based on Microservice Architecture : Taking small and medium-sized BtoC e-commerce system as an example
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the advancement and implementation of information technology, microservice architecture has gained popularity in current times. However, it remains challenging to decompose complex business logic into multiple services and effectively manage them. Using the e-commerce field as a case study, this paper innovatively applies horizontal and vertical partitioning methods combined with domain-driven design to divide services. This approach results in RestAPI microservices that implement business domain logic and WebUI microservices responsible for front-end display. The paper provides an overview of the fundamental microservices governing business microservices (RestAPI, WebUI). These basic microservices oversee multiple services distributed across different servers, clusters, or clouds by dynamically configuring inter-service invocation rules to ensure mutual cooperation and achieve comprehensive system functionality. The method of microservice decomposition is expanded upon to better meet the requirements of high performance, high availability, and high concurrency within e-commerce systems.

articleTitle: Quantum Convolutional Neural Network based on Variational Quantum Fuzzy Inference
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of quantum technology, quantum machine learning has attracted wide attention. In this paper, we propose a novel quantum machine learning model which introduces variational quantum gates in the quantum fuzzy inference circuits, and adjusts the variational gate parameters to automatically learn fuzzy rules for data classification through quantum machine learning training. Comparison results on the iris dataset show that our variational quantum fuzzy inference quantum convolutional neural network (VQFI-QCNN) outperforms classical multi layer perceptron (MLP) neural networks with a similar number of parameters, demonstrating the potential advantages of quantum. Due to the better results on the iris structured dataset, our VQFI-QCNN deserves further investigation, and as the number of quantum bits available for quantum computers increases, our method may also be applied in the future to efficiently classify structured data in mega data.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Data Operation and Maintenance Management Scheme*
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of information technology, various information systems are applied to enterprise management. Therefore, enterprises are also facing various information system management problems, especially the operation and maintenance management of production data of different information systems. The design of automation management aims at centralized management of production data, relies on data migration tool DATASTAGE, and uses Shell script to realize automatic data operation and maintenance management system. By regularly scheduling and executingthe extraction, conversion and loading (ETL) data of the automated data operation and maintenance management system, the centralized operation and maintenance management of the production data of different information systems of enterprises is realized, and the historical data of the database table is automatically backed up, deleted, migrated and saved. The system can better reduce the risk of operation andmaintenance, human error rate, improve the efficiency of operation and maintenance, and provide reference for the research of intelligent data operation and maintenance of heterogeneous data sources.

articleTitle: GAIPPTSC: An Efficient Container Tasks Orchestration and Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Containers are a very promising virtualization technology because of their lightweight, portable, and scalable advantages. In the case of mixed integer nolinear programming (MINP) problems such as orchestration and scheduling for container tasks, it is particularly important to combine heuristic methods to solve the problem. In order to solve the problem quickly and improve from a number of performance indicators, this paper firstly establishes a mixed integer nonlinear model for container tasks orchestration and scheduling scenarios, and then proposes a GAIPPTSC algorithm to obtain advantageous solutions in various indicators. In the experimental results, in terms of load balancing, the GAIPPTSC algorithm is 4.2% of the average of the other algorithms. Makespan also shortened by an average of 24.7%. In terms of energy consumption, it was reduced by an average of 53.6%. Overall communication overhead is also minimized. Correspondingly, the overall time cost of the algorithm is also increased by approximately 5 times, which is acceptable in the absolute time dimension. Therefore, the experiment proves the efficiency of the GAIPPTSC algorithm.

articleTitle: Investigating the Label-flipping Attacks Impact in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a collaborative model training approach that protects data privacy while allowing for model updates and optimization. However, FL is vulnerable to poisoning attacks due to its distributed nature. Among these attacks, label-flipping stands out for being straightforward to implement yet challenging to detect. Additionally, current research used to treat it as a black box, which could hinder the development of defense strategies. To fill this gap, this work investigates the impact of label-flipping attacks from multiple perspectives. Experiments are conducted using the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST dataset and an MLP (MultiLayer Perceptron) model. Results show that in label-flipping attacks, malicious clients primarily alter parameters in specific model components. Different flipping strategies also have varying effects on model parameters. Finally, this study compares label-flipping attacks with model poisoning attacks to better understand their differences. We’re looking forward to this work to offer insights for the FL community regarding label-flipping understanding and defense strategies.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of switch machine based on Genetic Algorithm-Optimized Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of fault diagnosis of existing switch machines, a fault diagnosis model based on genetic algorithm optimized BP was proposed. Firstly, the power data of S700K collected by microcomputer monitoring is classified, and the corresponding code is coded for each type of fault. Then the initial parameter values of the neural network and genetic algorithm are set. Finally, the neural network model is established, and the genetic algorithm is used to optimize the BP neural network, and the optimal network learning parameters are obtained, which realizes the recognition of different types of faults of the switch machine. The experimental results show that this method can identify the fault type of the switch machine effectively, and the recognition effect of GA-BP neural network is better than the traditional BP neural network, and the fault diagnosis accuracy reaches 97.5%.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Colouring of Sketch Images Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In this paper, we have designed an innovative deep learning model using U-net with PatchGAN discriminator aiming at automatic colouring of sketch images, which provides a novel solution for sketch colouring. Firstly, the image is passed through the dataset to the generator, which receives the input image and tries to convert it into the expected output image. Subsequently, in each iteration, the loss functions of the generator and the discriminator are calculated and the model parameters are updated by the optimiser. Finally, predictions are made on the test dataset and the results are plotted. By passing new unseen data to the trained generator, it was observed that the generation results were as expected and the deep learning coloured images were very close to the actual coloured images. This research brings important implications for the fields of digital art and computer vision. Firstly, it provides a completely new approach to processing sketch images, opening up more possibilities for artists and designers. Second, the model expands new ideas and examples for the application of deep learning techniques in the field of image processing. Finally, in practical applications, this auto-colouring technique is expected to greatly improve productivity and can be widely used in animation, comics and other fields.

articleTitle: Urban Rail Transit Passenger Flow Prediction Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of urban rail transit passenger flow prediction, this paper proposes a prediction model for urban rail transit passenger flow based on data mining. Firstly, factor analysis (FA) is used to model and analyze historical data affecting passenger flow to determine common factors and calculate scores. These common factor scores are then used as inputs, combined with the PSO-BP network prediction model for passenger flow forecasting. The forecast results of this model are compared with the prediction results of the PSO-BP model, and it is found that the forecast results of this model are closer to the actual passenger flow.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Enhancement Methods for Speech Recognition Text Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper addresses the need to improve the readability of speech recognition transcribed text by designing the speech recognition readability enhancement solution. It can better process the transcribed text from speech recognition and generate high-readability text for downstream applications. The paper proposes a method for synthesizing a readability dataset for speech recognition, and implements a new data augmentation method to solve the problem of the lack of dedicated training data for speech recognition readability research. In addition, a stage-based new training method is designed to better utilize the training data to improve model performance. Experimental results show that the speech recognition readability enhancement solution designed in this paper is able to generate text with higher readability than the related studies for speech recognition transcription.

articleTitle: UAV Anomaly Detection Model Based on Integrated Multi-Modal Neural Network and Neural Architecture Search
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of UAV technology, UAV anomaly detection has become one of the important tasks to ensure flight safety. However, traditional single-modal anomaly detection models face 3 challenges: 1. difficulty in fully extracting complex sensor features leading to information loss; 2. difficulty in integrating prediction results from heterogeneous neural networks reducing model performance; 3. difficulty in updating model parameters because of heavy reliance on prior knowledge. These limit the performance of UAV anomaly detection. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a UAV anomaly detection model based on an integrated multi-modal neural network and neural architecture search. Firstly, various heterogeneous neural networks are designed to extract features from UAV sensor data and provide a basis for the subsequent decision-making phase. Secondly, the hybrid soft-voting mechanism combines the prediction results of each model neural network to improve the accuracy of model detection. Finally, neural architecture search technology (NAS) is employed to construct and optimize multiple base classifiers automatically. These improve the detection performance. The experimental results show that the method achieves 98.02% accuracy on the ALFA dataset, about 3.39% higher than the base model.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Power Inspection Robot Based on Improved PSO Algorithm and Dynamic Window Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper proposes a path planning method for power inspection robot based on improved Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Dynamic Window Approach (DWA). First, we use an improved PSO (IPSO) to generate the globally optimal path. By introducing chaotic perturbations to initialize the initial state of particles, we can increase the convergence speed. Second, we extract the turning points from the planned global path as the target points, and the DWA algorithm is used to perform local path planning. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated in Matlab. By combining IPSO with DWA for power inspection robot path planning, the PSO algorithm performs global searching in the search space, aiming to find better solution spaces. The DWA algorithm optimizes the robot’s trajectory within the given velocity space, considering the dynamic constraints and local environment information, leading to the generation of the robot’s optimal motion path. The results indicate that the approach proposed in the article demonstrates good performance in path planning.

articleTitle: Advancing Bioheat Transfer Simulations: A GPU-Accelerated ADI-Finite Difference Method in Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This study investigates the enhancement of bioheat transfer simulations via a GPU-accelerated Alternating Direction Implicit-Finite Difference Method (ADI-FDM). Bioheat transfer is pivotal in biomedical engineering, particularly for non-invasive thermal therapies and the design of medical devices; thus, precise and swift computational models are of utmost importance. Our innovative GPU-accelerated ADI-FDM tackles the dual challenges of computational accuracy and speed when modeling heat distribution in biological tissues. Leveraging parallel GPU computing, our approach achieves marked advancements in managing intricate boundary conditions and slashes computational time. Validation of our simulations against analytical solutions reveals an impressive accuracy, with less than 1.1% discrepancy, underscoring the reliability of our method. This computational leap accelerates simulations, potentially revolutionizing thermal therapy techniques and enhancing patient care. Our findings and methods have far-reaching consequences for future research and application, highlighting the escalating importance of GPU-accelerated simulations in bioheat transfer advancements.

articleTitle: Deniable and Accountable Searchable Message-Moderation System with Multi-Recipient
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Encrypted retrieval for multiple recipients ensures secure retrieval of encrypted messages and achieves confidentiality. Its application in database systems has made the primitive noteworthy. Traditional encryption retrieval struggles to provide message-moderation once a malicious sender transmits incorrect messages. We present the concept of searchable message-moderation with multi-recipient. In a word, our scheme achieved by combining asymmetric group message franking and searchable encryption with multi-recipient. Security analysis shows the scheme meet confidentiality, accountability, deniability and receiver anonymity. Finally, we conducted an efficiency analysis of the proposed scheme, demonstrating that it is efficient and practical.

articleTitle: Lightweight YOLOv8 Model for Weed Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In recent years, smart agriculture has emerged as an effective means to enhance crop yields, with weed removal in fields being a critical factor directly impacting production. Traditional methods for weed control often involve the extensive use of herbicides, which can lead to overuse and negatively affect crop health. This paper proposes a lightweight YOLO model tailored for weed detection. Compared to the original YOLO model, this lightweight version maintains comparable recognition accuracy while significantly reducing hardware computational requirements. Specifically, in terms of billion floating-point operations (GFLOPs), the lightweight YOLO model reduces hardware demands by 30.6% compared to the original model. Experimental results demonstrate that the lightweight model exhibits notable advantages in weed detection, effectively broadening its application scope.

articleTitle: Cluster-Based Two-Stage Client Selection Strategy for Personalized Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Data heterogeneity poses a significant challenge in federated learning, often leading to slow convergence and reduced accuracy. To address this, we propose an adaptive clustered federated learning algorithm that uses the Silhouette Coefficient to determine the optimal number of clusters, thereby grouping clients with similar data distributions and mitigating the impact of data heterogeneity. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage client selection strategy—comprising inter-cluster and intra-cluster selection—that enhances model performance and convergence. By considering both the discrepancy between group and global models and the utility of individual clients, our approach ensures a balanced and effective federated learning process. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets for variable data heterogeneity levels reveal that the proposed algorithm consistently outperforms baselines in terms of higher accuracy (up to 2.91%) and is robust to the number of participants.

articleTitle: Stator Winding Temperature Detection Method of High Voltage Motor Based on All-phase FFT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: AC dehumidification drying is applied to the high voltage motor that is damp, and the temperature detection is beneficial to judge the insulation state of the motor. The stator winding impedance is obtained by measuring the voltage and current signal applied to the stator winding, and the temperature is calculated by the resistance extrapolation method. However, the traditional data processing method FFT spectrum analysis has a large spectrum leakage problem in the non-spectral line of voltage and current signal data. The introduction of all-phase FFT(apFFT) spectrum analysis can identify the original signal characteristic quantity with low error, and use FFT/apFFT phase difference method to correct the measured phase, amplitude and frequency. The test program designed according to apFFT can calculate the impedance of stator windings with high precision, which has a guiding effect on the practical application of temperature measurement.
